set -euo pipefail; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

p = Path('platformio.ini')
s = p.read_text()
old = '-DAPP_VERSION=\\"1.0.0\\"'
new = '-DAPP_VERSION=\\"1.0.1\\"'
if s.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one APP_VERSION 1.0.0, found {s.count(old)}')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))

p = Path('github.md')
s = p.read_text()
anchor = '- Nie nadpisuj ani nie cofaj lokalnych zmian uzytkownika bez wyraznej prosby.\n'
addition = '''- Nie merguj `main` z powrotem do `develop` tylko po to, aby zsynchronizowac snapshot wydania.\n- Po wydaniu zsynchronizuj do `develop` tylko metadane bazowej wersji (np. `APP_VERSION` i wersje pakietu), jesli release podbil je wylacznie na `main`.\n- Rozbieznosc historii `main` i `develop` jest oczekiwana w tym modelu: `main` przechowuje snapshoty wydan, a `develop` szczegolowa historie rozwoju.\n'''
if addition.strip() not in s:
    if anchor not in s:
        raise SystemExit('github.md policy anchor not found')
    p.write_text(s.replace(anchor, anchor + addition, 1))

p = Path('AGENTS.md')
s = p.read_text()
anchor = '- Set `work_branch` explicitly. Follow MatrixHub Git policy: normal development is on `develop`; `main` is the stable release line unless the user explicitly requests another branch.\n'
addition = '- For release snapshots and post-release branch synchronization, follow `github.md`; do not merge `main` back into `develop` merely to import a release snapshot.\n'
if addition not in s:
    if anchor not in s:
        raise SystemExit('AGENTS.md branch-policy anchor not found')
    p.write_text(s.replace(anchor, anchor + addition, 1))
PY
cd interface; npm version 1.0.1 --no-git-tag-version --ignore-scripts >/dev/null; cd ..; test -z "$(git diff --name-only | grep -v -E '^(platformio.ini|interface/package.json|interface/package-lock.json|github.md|AGENTS.md)$' || true)"; git diff --check; git diff --stat
